about_p1: Todd and his son are both friendly and knowledgeable. They fixed my son's catalytic converter on his Chevy Cruze so it would pass inspection. They also did work on my dodge challenger to make it sound great! They are a local shop and care about their customers. I highly recommend them to anyone that needs or wants exhaust work.
about_p2: Can't recommend Carolina Car Care enough. Got some exhaust work done on my Ram and was provided top notch service by the owner at a very reasonable price. There's a reason they've been in business this long. Outstanding! The owner is nice and won't rip you off. I'm a lady and I had looked up how much to expect for the part that was thought to be messed up. It was almost $400.

reviews.author: B
reviews.text: Todd and his son are both friendly and knowledgeable. They fixed my son's catalytic converter on his Chevy Cruze so it would pass inspection. They also did work on my dodge challenger to make it sound great! They are a local shop and care about their customers. I highly recommend them to anyone that needs or wants exhaust work.

reviews.author: John Kenyon
reviews.text: Can't recommend Carolina Car Care enough. Got some exhaust work done on my Ram and was provided top notch service by the owner at a very reasonable price. There's a reason they've been in business this long. Outstanding!

reviews.author: Stitch lover
reviews.text: The owner is nice and won't rip you off. I'm a lady and I had looked up how much to expect for the part that was thought to be messed up. It was almost $400. But, when the owner gave me the price he only charged me $175. I was so thankful.

reviews.author: Adam Troutman
reviews.text: I could not be more pleased with the service. Very knowledgeable and helpful. My exhaust was rattling and unbeknownst to me had a hole in the tail pipe as well. My new muffler was installed and he bent and replaced the custom pipe that had a leak. The work was great and priced fairly.

reviews.author: Steve t
reviews.text: I was recommended to this location and was very satisfied. The service, the price, and the finished result were greater than anticipated. I will recommend this shop to anyone in need of some custom and traditional exhaust work.
